statusHistory.detail: In the past four weeks, the Government of Canada announced over $3.6 billion in new programs and investments to advance Canada's critical minerals sector, alongside 30 new partnerships under the Critical Minerals Production Alliance that will unlock $12.1 billion in critical minerals projects nationally. Additionally, Saskatchewan-based Cameco secured a $2.6 billion uranium supply agreement with India.
statusHistory.note: Saskatchewan's Cameco signed a $2.6 billion long-term uranium supply agreement with India. Nationally, the Critical Minerals Production Alliance unlocked $12.1 billion in critical minerals projects across Canada, impacting provinces like Saskatchewan.
